# betterado_git_repository_file (Data Source)

Reads a file from a Git repository in Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

data "betterado_git_repository" "example" {
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "ExampleRepo"
}

data "betterado_git_repository_file" "example" {
  repository_id = data.betterado_git_repository.example.id
  file          = "README.md"
  branch        = "refs/heads/main"
}

output "file_content" {
  value = data.betterado_git_repository_file.example.content
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file` (String) The file path.
- `repository_id` (String) The repository ID.

### Optional

- `branch` (String) The branch name, no default.
- `tag` (String) Optional tag name, no default.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The file's content.
- `id` (String) The ID of the data source.
- `last_commit_message` (String) The last commit message.
